items.raw_excerpt: La cinta competirá en la categoría Infantil: Acción Real en la ceremonia que se realizará en Nueva York.
items.summary_en: The Chilean children's show 31 Minutos was nominated for an International Emmy Award. Its holiday movie Calurosa Navidad was nominated in the Kids: Live Action category. The awards ceremony will be held in New York.
items.summary_ko: 칠레 어린이 프로그램 '31분'이 국제 에미상 후보로 선정됐다. 크리스마스 특별영화 '따뜻한 크리스마스'가 어린이 실사극 부문에 후보로 올랐다. 시상식은 뉴욕에서 열린다.
items.title_en: Chilean TV show for kids gets an International Emmy nomination
items.title_ko: 칠레 어린이 방송 '31분' 국제 에미상 후보 선정
items.title_original: Película "Calurosa Navidad" de 31 Minutos fue nominada a un Emmy Internacional

items.raw_excerpt: "Tu'un Natee" reúne 16 poemas en la lengua del pueblo ñuu savi y traducido al español; la obra fue elaborada durante ocho años de trabajo
items.summary_en: The book "Tu'un Natee" collects 16 poems written in the native language of a village in Oaxaca, Mexico. The language is called Nuu Savi. The poems were translated into Spanish. The work took eight years to finish.
items.summary_ko: "투운 나테"라는 책이 멕시코 옥사카의 한 마을 토착 언어인 누 사비어로 쓰인 시 16편을 모았다. 시들은 스페인어로 번역도 돼 있다. 이 작업에는 8년이 걸렸다.
items.title_en: A Book of Poems in Oaxaca Village Language Is Released
items.title_ko: 옥사카 마을 언어로 된 시집 한 권이 세상에 나오다
items.title_original: Presentan "Tu'un Natee", libro que reescribe la memoria colectiva de un pueblo ñuu savi de Oaxaca - El Universal Oaxaca

items.raw_excerpt: A small but positive increase in the number of dugongs spotted in coastal areas in south-east Queensland has researchers feeling cautiously optimistic about the vulnerable marine mammal achieving population revival.
items.summary_en: More dugongs have been seen in coastal areas of south-east Queensland. Researchers are cautiously hopeful that the shy sea mammal is starting to recover. It is still rare and still at risk.
items.summary_ko: 호주 동남부 퀸스랜드 해안에서 서식하는 듀공이 조금 늘었다. 연구자들은 이 겁 많은 바다 짐승이 회복 기미를 보인다고 조심스럽게 기대한다. 하지만 여전히 드물고 위험에 처해 있다.
items.title_en: Hervey Bay dugongs grow for the first time in years
items.title_original: Hervey Bay's dugongs make positive start on slow road to recovery

items.raw_excerpt: CM Fadnavis and DCM Shinde visit drought-affected Maharashtra, addressing farmers' concerns and announcing relief measures.
items.summary_en: The chief minister and deputy chief minister of Maharashtra visited areas hit by drought. They met farmers, listened to their problems, and promised relief help. Farmers in the region have had a weak monsoon and low water supplies.
items.title_en: Maharashtra chief ministers visit dry farms
items.title_original: CM Fadnavis and DCM Shinde visit drought-prone regions in Maharashtra
